title: Apple (AAPL) Issues Quarterly Earnings Results
text:
Apple (AAPL) Issues Quarterly Earnings Results Posted by Caroline Horne | Feb 1st, 2018 
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) announced its quarterly earnings results on Thursday. The iPhone maker reported $3.89 earnings per share (EPS) for the quarter, topping the consensus estimate of $3.75 by $0.14, Bloomberg Earnings reports. The business had revenue of $88.29 billion for the quarter, compared to analyst estimates of $87.62 billion. Apple had a return on equity of 36.29% and a net margin of 21.09%. The company’s quarterly revenue was up 12.7% on a year-over-year basis. During the same quarter in the prior year, the company earned $3.36 earnings per share. 
Shares of Apple ( NASDAQ AAPL ) traded up $0.35 on Thursday, hitting $167.78. The company had a trading volume of 43,831,342 shares, compared to its average volume of 29,150,000. The company has a quick ratio of 1.23, a current ratio of 1.28 and a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.73. The stock has a market capitalization of $861,430.00, a P/E ratio of 18.26, a price-to-earnings-growth ratio of 1.35 and a beta of 1.23. Apple has a one year low of $127.01 and a one year high of $180.10. Get Apple alerts: 
The firm also recently declared a quarterly dividend, which will be paid on Thursday, February 15th. Investors of record on Monday, February 12th will be given a dividend of $0.63 per share. This represents a $2.52 dividend on an annualized basis and a dividend yield of 1.50%. Apple’s payout ratio is 27.42%. 
In related news, insider Daniel J. Riccio sold 15,641 shares of the stock in a transaction that occurred on Tuesday, November 14th. The stock was sold at an average price of $172.35, for a total transaction of $2,695,726.35. Following the completion of the sale, the insider now directly owns 39,682 shares of the company’s stock, valued at $6,839,192.70. The sale was disclosed in a document filed with the Securities & Exchange Commission, which is accessible through this hyperlink . Also, insider Eduardo H. Cue sold 65,361 shares of the stock in a transaction that occurred on Thursday, November 30th. The shares were sold at an average price of $171.60, for a total value of $11,215,947.60. The disclosure for this sale can be found here . Insiders have sold 128,412 shares of company stock valued at $22,115,155 over the last ninety days. 0.08% of the stock is currently owned by company insiders. 
Several institutional investors and hedge funds have recently modified their holdings of AAPL. Americafirst Capital Management LLC purchased a new stake in Apple in the third quarter worth $313,000. Gyroscope Capital Management Group LLC increased its position in Apple by 39.2% in the third quarter. Gyroscope Capital Management Group LLC now owns 21,540 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $3,320,000 after buying an additional 6,061 shares during the last quarter. Yellowstone Partners LLC purchased a new stake in Apple in the third quarter worth $5,449,000. Independent Advisor Alliance increased its position in Apple by 3.7% in the third quarter. Independent Advisor Alliance now owns 132,762 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $20,690,000 after buying an additional 4,706 shares during the last quarter. Finally, Fieldpoint Private Securities LLC increased its position in Apple by 9.1% in the third quarter. Fieldpoint Private Securities LLC now owns 33,989 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $5,238,000 after buying an additional 2,830 shares during the last quarter. 60.26% of the stock is owned by institutional investors. 
Several brokerages have issued reports on AAPL. Loop Capital reiterated a “buy” rating and issued a $195.00 price target (down previously from $200.00) on shares of Apple in a report on Wednesday. BMO Capital Markets lowered Apple from an “outperform” rating to a “market perform” rating and increased their price target for the stock from $166.97 to $195.00 in a report on Wednesday. Vetr upgraded Apple from a “buy” rating to a “strong-buy” rating and set a $190.70 price target on the stock in a report on Tuesday. Bank of America reiterated a “buy” rating and issued a $220.00 price target on shares of Apple in a report on Tuesday. Finally, HSBC set a $204.00 price target on Apple and gave the stock a “buy” rating in a report on Tuesday. Two analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, twelve have assigned a hold rating, thirty-seven have assigned a buy rating and two have issued a strong buy rating to the company’s stock. The company currently has a consensus rating of “Buy” and an average price target of $201.25. Apple Company Profile 
Apple Inc (Apple) designs, manufactures and markets mobile communication and media devices, personal computers, and portable digital music players, and a variety of related software, services, peripherals, networking solutions, and third-party digital content and applications. The Company’s products and services include iPhone, iPad, Mac, iPod, Apple TV, a portfolio of consumer and professional software applications, the iOS and OS X operating systems, iCloud, and a variety of accessory, service and support offerings.
